metric_definitions.full_rated_normalized_rms: sqrt(mean over samples and 12 joints of (estimated torque/rated torque)^2)
metric_definitions.walk_rms: arithmetic mean of 12 individual joint RMS values
metric_definitions.stand_rms: maximum of individual joint RMS/rated torque within each consecutive STAND segment
metric_definitions.forward_progress: last world Y minus first world Y
metric_definitions.walk_command_mae: mean abs(body-frame velocity Y - status command Y) during WALK
metric_definitions.sample_interval: timestamp labels denote fixed 5ms slots; last stamp 27.995s covers through 28s
